name: XLA_DIAG_SOURCES
description: This table is used to contain the source values retrieved from the transaction objects by the Diagnostic Framework.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Accounting event internal identifier.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a self-contained accounting information set for single or multiple legal or management entities.

columns.name: SOURCE_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Short name of the transaction information that is used to create journal entries.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the source is predefined by subledger application.

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Internal identifier of the source application.

columns.name: SOURCE_ORIGIN_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the subledger source or formula is predefined.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Transaction object line number.

columns.name: SLA_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Subledger accounting ledger internal identifier.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_LANGUAGE
columns.description: Abbreviated name associated with description language.

columns.name: OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Name of transaction object or reference object that contains a specific source.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Owner of the transaction object.

columns.name: SOURCE_VALUE
columns.description: Actual value that is passed to the transaction object columns.

columns.name: SOURCE_MEANING
columns.description: Contains the meaning of the lookup code if the source is associated with a lookup.  If the source is not associated with any lookup type, then this column is left blank.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
